year.fruit: A mushroom: egg-yellow, funnel-shaped, usually in small groups. Comes up from July to early October, most of all in August.
year.notes: 3-8 cm across, with blunt, branching ridges instead of gills running down the stem, and a faint smell of apricots. Grows in mossy spruce and mixed forest, living together with the trees' roots. A favourite of Finnish mushroom pickers; slugs and squirrels eat it too.
